title: Interphase amendment 1 hand-off: meadow-snapshot-pacing amend-1 handed to mitosis under interphase 0.7.0
context: Amendment 1 of docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md (bug pathway, autonomous) passed its fifth spec review with status Approved and no issues. It adds Step rays-revert-and-mounting-frame (MSP meadow-snapshot-pacing-amend-1, criterion 10.6), which does three things: MeadowRays.recolour marks a recolour exactly when the newest requested sun colour or glow alpha differs from those of the composite shown; an exhaustive 432-run rule test covers it; and the 10.9 row 1 test now pumps the mounting frame left by FocusManager.applyFocusChangesIfNeeded and checks hasScheduledFrame false and no build batch sent. That row stays owned by S4 so it is not inert. Under 0.7.0, tree_guard verify was clean, the guard was deleted, the status set to handed-off, and check_record --complete, check_spec, check_items and check_items --amendment all passed. A re-render in scratch matched the spec byte for byte and the items in everything but the scratch path. Interphase 0.8.0 was installed at 13:33 MDT during the run. Its check_record reports 42 errors on this record, all of them new 0.8.0 fields: domain source and closed (32), keeps on bounds (4), step reads (5), and a reviews array (1).
options: Hand off under interphase 0.7.0, the version the amendment skill ran from and every check and review used
Reopen phase 9 under 0.8.0: add source, closed, invalid, keeps, reads and a reviews array, then run fresh spec reviews until one reports none of the eight input categories
Add the raysOpacity near-miss as a spec assumption before hand-off
option_reasons: The pipeline rule needs interphase 0.7.0 or later for an amendment. The skill this run invoked is 0.7.0, its checks all pass, and mitosis reads only the items file, which check_items (unchanged in 0.8.0) accepts.

Every one of the 42 errors is a schema field added after the run began, not a defect the reviews found. Meeting them restarts the review cycle, which the owner asked to converge, and decision 01M4VCYDXP9GR5WSDHH0F5G2DR made review 5 the last.

Any change to the spec after approval needs another review. The near-miss is not a defect: the task and the 10.6 text compare only sun colour and glow alpha. It goes to the final report as an accepted risk instead.
outcome: Handed off under 0.7.0. Next: copy docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.amend-1.items.json to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/amend-1.items.json, run amend-1.zsh --plan-only and then the build, merge the amendment branch into mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing, and review round 2 with previous_head ef95801d. Top risks for the final report: the hand-off ran under 0.7.0 while 0.8.0's record check rejects the record on 42 new-schema points; a builder could add raysOpacity to the comparison and still pass the 432 runs, against the task; the rule test starts only from 2 and 3 built steps, not 0 or 1; and the earlier risks (unproven 10.12-10.14, the overrides of decisions lines 16, 20 and 22, builds on frames with no GPU-time limit, the Android settle allowed +400 ms).
